about: Each milestone's done-when gates from the plan. A gate passes only with evidence, such as a command, a CI run, or a file. Claude flips 'passes' only after running the check.

gates.check: uv run manim -ql examples/hello.py Hello renders a video
uv run pytest passes
uv run pre-commit run --all-files passes

gates.evidence: content/cis5200/episodes/E01-knn/render.sh renders a 102-second, two-segment episode with sound; contact sheets reviewed in four rounds

gates.evidence: examples/econ-supply-demand/ knowledge map with 13 concepts and outline; tests/test_examples.py passes

gates.evidence: docs/formats.md, with a public economics example and a private CIS 5200 example for each format

gates.check: The repo's docs pass the written profile in CI
gates.evidence: the lint-docs pre-commit hook passed in CI run 37571602753
